PerezBlanco2026
===============

Wrist-motion (4-direction pointing) motor-execution dataset [1]_.

Dataset Overview
----------------
  Code: PerezBlanco2026
  Paradigm: imagery
  DOI: 10.1038/s41597-026-07287-z
  Subjects: 45
  Sessions per subject: 1
  Events: flexion=1, extension=2, radial_deviation=3, ulnar_deviation=4
  Trial interval: [0, 2.5] s
  Runs per session: 8
  File format: EDF (BIDS, converted from BCI2000 .dat)

Acquisition
-----------
  Sampling rate: 512.0 Hz
  Number of channels: 16
  Channel types: eeg=8, emg=8
  Channel names: C3, C1, Cz, C2, C4, CP3, CPz, CP4
  Montage: 10-10
  Hardware: g.tec g.USBamp (serial UB-2016.05.01)
  Reference: right ear
  Ground: AFz
  Line frequency: 60.0 Hz
  Online filters: {'bandpass': [0.1, 200.0], 'notch': 60.0}
  Cap manufacturer: g.tec
  Cap model: g.GAMMAcap
  Auxiliary channels: EMG (8 ch)

Participants
------------
  Number of subjects: 45
  Health status: healthy
  Age: mean=38.5, std=19.87, min=20.0, max=83.0
  Gender distribution: female=26, male=19
  Handedness: {'right': 40, 'left': 5}
  Species: human

Experimental Protocol
---------------------
  Paradigm: imagery
  Task type: motor_execution
  Number of classes: 4
  Class labels: flexion, extension, radial_deviation, ulnar_deviation
  Trial duration: 10.0 s
  Study design: 4-direction wrist-pointing task with a 3-DoF wrist exoskeleton (Biomech Wrist). Flexion-extension controls horizontal cursor motion, radial-ulnar deviation controls vertical cursor motion. 8 runs x 40 trials (10 per movement per run).
  Feedback type: continuous visual
  Stimulus type: visual target
  Stimulus modalities: visual
  Primary modality: visual
  Synchronicity: cue-based
  Mode: offline

HED Event Annotations
---------------------
  Schema: HED 8.4.0 | Browse: https://www.hedtags.org/hed-schema-browser

  flexion
    ├─ Sensory-event
    └─ Label/flexion

  extension
    ├─ Sensory-event
    └─ Label/extension

  radial_deviation
    ├─ Sensory-event
    └─ Label/radial_deviation

  ulnar_deviation
    ├─ Sensory-event
    └─ Label/ulnar_deviation

Paradigm-Specific Parameters
----------------------------
  Detected paradigm: motor_imagery
  Imagery tasks: flexion, extension, radial_deviation, ulnar_deviation
  Imagery duration: 2.5 s

Data Structure
--------------
  Trials: 320
  Trials per class: flexion=80, extension=80, radial_deviation=80, ulnar_deviation=80
  Trials context: 45 subjects x >=8 runs x 40 trials (10 per class per run); the exact run count varies by subject (e.g. 9 for sub-01, 10 for sub-02), so per-subject totals exceed this minimum

Cross-Validation
----------------
  Evaluation type: within_subject

BCI Application
---------------
  Applications: motor_control, rehabilitation
  Environment: laboratory
  Online feedback: True

Tags
----
  Pathology: Healthy
  Modality: Motor
  Type: Motor Execution

Ethics
------
Ethics approval: the data analysed in this deposit were collected under the
ethics approval obtained by the original investigators and reported in the
primary publication cited above (see References/Documentation sections of
this README). Participants gave informed consent in the source study. No
new human-subject data were collected during this BIDS re-release; this
NEMAR record only reformats the published source data into BIDS via MOABB.
Please consult the primary publication for the exact IRB/ethics committee
reference.

## Ethics

Approved by the Institutional Research Ethics Committee of Tecnologico de Monterrey, approval number PR2024-05v1. The study was conducted in accordance with the Declaration of Helsinki, and written informed consent — including explicit agreement for open sharing of de-identified data — was obtained from all participants (Perez-Blanco et al. 2026, Sci. Data, DOI 10.1038/s41597-026-07287-z).
